title: Security — OAuth2/PKCE, JWT, OWASP
exp: Be fluent in auth code + PKCE, JWT validation claims, and the OWASP issues that hit .NET APIs.
pts: Auth Code + PKCE for public clients; exchange code for tokens server-side or with verifier.
Validate JWT: issuer, audience, lifetime, signature (and preferably `typ`).
OWASP: parameterized SQL/EF, encode XSS, antiforgery for cookies, secrets in Key Vault, DTOs against over-posting.
Password hashing: Identity / PBKDF2 / Argon2 / bcrypt — never raw SHA.
AuthN vs AuthZ: who you are vs what you can do (policies/roles).

qa.q: Explain Authorization Code flow with PKCE.
qa.a: Client sends authorize request with code_challenge; user authenticates; AS returns a code; client exchanges code + code_verifier for tokens. PKCE stops intercepted codes from being redeemed by attackers who lack the verifier.

qa.q: Name five OWASP mitigations you'd apply to an ASP.NET API.
qa.a: Parameterized queries/EF; output encoding; CSRF protection for cookie sessions; secrets out of source; least-privilege authZ policies; strict DTOs; security headers; dependency scanning.
